blocks.text: Jeremiah 8 contains 22 verses. It opens with: At that time, saith Jehovah, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves; It concludes with: Is there no balm in Gilead? is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
